needed.why: Read repositories, push aico/task-* branches, open and merge pull requests.
Read the required approvers and branch permissions.

warnings: Bitbucket does not say whether this token may write; if a push or pull request is refused, the token needs Repository (or Project) write.
Checks (build statuses) are unreadable with this token, so pull requests will show no builds.
Branch protection unreadable (needs repository admin): AICO cannot see which approvers and builds main requires. The server still enforces them at merge.
Bitbucket Data Center has no sprints or work items here (they live in Jira, which is not supported), so AICO's sprints stay local.

mergeBlockers: A reviewer has marked it "needs work".
Bitbucket was not asked whether this can be merged (the token cannot read it).
